lead: A gentle, fiber-matched clean that lifts out ground-in grit without stressing the weave or bleeding the dyes.
cardDescription: A gentle, fiber-matched clean for synthetic runners to wool heirlooms, with the dyes tested first.
homeDescription: Careful cleaning for the rugs you don't want to trust to just anyone.

whatsIncluded.label: Fiber & colorfast test
whatsIncluded.description: I identify the fiber and test the dyes first, so nothing bleeds or shrinks.

whatsIncluded.label: Gentle deep clean
whatsIncluded.description: A low-stress wash matched to your rug lifts out grit and years of dulling dirt.

whatsIncluded.label: Fringe & edge care
whatsIncluded.description: Fringes and bound edges get cleaned by hand, where the wear usually starts.

whatsIncluded.label: Dried flat & fully
whatsIncluded.description: Rugs are dried flat and all the way through, so there's no mildew smell or backing damage.

faq.q: Do you take the rug away?
faq.a: Most rugs I can clean right in your home. Delicate or heavily soiled ones may be better cleaned off-site. I'll let you know.

faq.q: Is it safe for wool and specialty rugs?
faq.a: Yes. I match the method to the fiber and always test the dyes first so colors don't run.
Synthetic rugs dry in a few hours; thick wool can take a day. I dry them flat so the backing isn't stressed.

faq.q: Can you get pet stains out of a rug?
faq.a: Often, yes. I'll add an enzyme treatment for odor and tell you honestly how much will lift.
